title: micromeria dalmatica
intro: Micromeria dalmatica, commonly known as Dalmatian pennyroyal or Dalmatian mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to aid in digestion, reduce menstrual cramps, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The health benefits of Micromeria dalmatica include its potential to act as an antispasmodic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory, while its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Micromeria dalmatica include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
